title: We covered the forest's loudest singers
storyboard: Film: 4 nature-club kids at a mic copying a peacock call and an elephant rumble, then laughing; 2 takes

scenes.headline: Cover song: the original artists are animals
Indian peafowl: an extremely loud, harsh shriek
Asian elephant: rumbles too low for us to hear well
Covers are for the club room.
scenes.body: On trails we listen quietly and never play calls to pull wild birds closer.

caption:
Our nature club tried covering two very different voices.

Elephant rumbles are infrasonic: other elephants can pick them up more than 3 km away, while we barely hear them.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo, Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Medium risk (composition rights) sidestepped entirely: the 'song' covered is an animal call, so no composition is used; adds a field-ethics line on call playback.
